messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: 3xx->5xx error spike for /v1/generate in eu-west-1. 5m error rate 12% (baseline 0.6%), latency p95 2.3s. Suspected smart-routing fallbacks. Pager: sam (oncall).

sam (oncall): looking. seeing a flurry of 502/504s at the ingress layer, and lots of rapid retries from a handful of client IP blocks.

maya (sre): echo - we count ~30k requests/min hitting variant `gptx-16q` in eu-west that usually sits at ~3k. autoscale didn't kick because variant mapping pinned to wrong pool.

carla (runtime): digging into routing logs. smart-routing policy for tenant-tier PROD had a fallback rule mapped `gptx-16b` -> `gptx-16q` for cost/compat. Looks like a recent policy change (config pushed ~2365008000) didn't include capacity constraints.

dave (product): fyi this started right after the model-catalog refresh earlier this morning. Could be a variant aliasing issue.

sam (oncall): mitigation plan: 1) disable cross-variant fallback for eu-west, 2) apply temporary rate-limit on that tenant to stop client retries from amplifying, 3) trigger manual scale up of dedicated pool. I'll execute unless objections.

ingrid (support): we already see a handful of customers hitting timeouts, raising tickets. Please prioritize a short mitigation so we can update customers.

carla (runtime): agree. disabling fallback now via `redwoodctl routing update --policy smart-routing --region eu-west-1 --disable-variant-fallback`

ops-bot: Command received: routing update started by carla.

sam (oncall): pushing rate limit rule: `ratelimit add tenant:acct-45 eu-west-1 20r/s burst=50 5m` to break retry spiral.

ops-bot: Rate limit applied.

maya (sre): manual scale requested: `infra scale pool dpool-eu-west-1 --gpus +4` — queued, estimated spin-up 3m.

carla (runtime): i can confirm error spike dropping after fallback disabled + rate limit. p50 latency back to 180ms, p95 620ms. still some queued requests draining.

sam (oncall): handing to carla for runtime follow-up. I'll stay on the thread for customer comms. Paging PD if pool scale doesn't finish.

carla (runtime): following up: found policy diff patch that introduced a default fallback route without a capacity check. snippet:
```
- fallback:
-  preferred: local-variant
+ fallback:
+  preferred: local-variant
+  allow_unbounded: true   # <-- bad, should be false or quota-guarded
```
I'll revert the change in staging and push hotfix to prod after validation.

maya (sre): pool scaled. observed sustained throughput increase. error rate now ~0.9% (spike window accounted).

ingrid (support): reporting back to impacted customers that we applied mitigation and are rolling a fix. some customers are asking for SLA credit estimation.

dave (product): capture which alias mapping caused the wrong variant. I want the model-catalog change ID.

carla (runtime): model-catalog change id `mc-20260503-77a`. That added alias `gptx-16b:cheap` -> `gptx-16q`. Will open PR to add quota/guardrails on fallback and a canary for alias changes.

sam (oncall): summary for handoff: fallback disabled in eu-west at 2365009920, tenant ratelimit applied, pool +4 GPUs at 2365009990, error rate returned to baseline by 2365010300. Assigning follow-ups to carla (runtime) and maya (sre).

carla (runtime): follow-ups: 1) revert allow_unbounded flag + add capacity check (PR queued), 2) add unit test for alias->variant mapping to fail if target not capacity-tagged, 3) add alert rule: if fallback causes >3x normal variant traffic, page SRE.

maya (sre): infra follow-ups: 1) ensure autoscale honors variant-level quotas, 2) add circuit-breaker to prevent pool spin-up loops, 3) examine client retry patterns and publish recommended exponential backoff guidance.

sam (oncall): tagging incident for postmortem. severity: sev2 (multi-customer partial outage). customers impacted: 4 paying customers, ~2% of overall traffic in eu-west during window.

dave (product): also check whether canary rollout for model-catalog changes is in place — if not, schedule immediate canary gating.

ingrid (support): will coordinate customer comms draft.

carla (runtime): hotfix deployed at 2365010350. will monitor for 2hrs before closing.

maya (sre): monitoring looks stable. leaving a note to improve observability: add `variant-origin` tag to all traces so we can track fallback flows in dashboards.

sam (oncall): thanks team. will open postmortem template and assign owners.

incident-bot: Incident acknowledged and ticket created: INC-2026-4873.

carla (runtime): quick log excerpt for postmortem:
```
2026-05-03T08:12:10Z routing: alias resolve: gptx-16b:cheap -> gptx-16q (capacity_tag=none)
2026-05-03T08:12:11Z runtime: pool=dpool-eu-west-1 concurrent=980 limit=256
2026-05-03T08:12:12Z ingress: client_retry: acct-45 attempt=5 backoff=0.1s
```

maya (sre): thanks. closing on-call handoff: routing and runtime owning remediation actions.

sam (oncall): closing thread for active mitigation; leave it open for postmortem follow-ups. :thumbsup:
